title: Configuration Fingerprint
description: Stable fingerprint of an effective run configuration. The fingerprint is the SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON serialization of configuration_sources and component_versions. Canonical serialization: keys sorted lexicographically, arrays in listed order, no whitespace, UTF-8 encoded. Identical effective configurations produce identical fingerprints; any meaningful configuration change produces a different fingerprint. Recorded in run metadata per docs/observability.md Run overview.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical serialized effective configuration (sorted keys, compact JSON, UTF-8).

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to compute the fingerprint.

path.description: Repository-relative path to a configuration source.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the configuration source contents.

configuration_sources.description: Configuration sources included in the fingerprint, with their content digests.

component_versions.description: Component versions included in the fingerprint.

computed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the fingerprint was computed.

version.description: Schema version of the configuration-fingerprint record format.
